descript: The Nike Air Force 1 Shadow puts a playful twist on a classic b-ball design. Using a layered approach, double the branding and an exaggerated midsole, it highlights AF1 DNA with a bold look.

Everything you love about the AF1—but doubled! The Nike Air Force 1 Shadow puts a playful twist on a hoops icon to highlight the best of AF1 DNA. Layered overlays bring added depth while doubled branding and an exaggerated midsole help give these sneakers a bold look. Vibrant colors provide an energetic look for 2 times the style

Inspired by the original that debuted in 1985, the Air Jordan 1 Low offers a clean, classic look that's familiar yet always fresh. With an iconic design that pairs perfectly with any 'fit, these kicks ensure you'll always be on point.
